system.description: Through a deeper dreamlike trance requiring 20 minutes of preparation, the oneiromancer travels into the collective unconscious. If she wins a Simple Challenge with the Storyteller, she receives a more explicit prophetic vision or breakthrough regarding herself or a person previously contacted via Foresee or Dreamspeak. This power may be used only once per night, and dream-symbols may still be misleading. This power requires the presence of a Storyteller or Narrator to provide results, and requires at least five minutes of dreamlike trance beforehand.
system.duration: 20 minutes of preparation, once per night
